THE MORPHINE ROUTE.

Fred Buck Found in an Unconscious State at Savoy.

Remarks of a Citizen of Savoy Brought to Notice in a Manner Through the Press

Sa[?]oy, Tex., May 20.— Yesterday afternoon, as Fred [?] and [?] were [?] the station at Savoy, they found a young man, Fred Buck, lying apparently dead on the platform. He was still alive, but breathing barely. Physician[?] F[illegible] was summoned to the[?] emergency room[?] and[?] on his[?] side[?] and[?] condition[?] was [illegible] a morphine [?]. As they passed the station Buck was treated at [illegible] still asleep to [?] in the [?] county [?] hospital[?].
